title: Is the Elephant Flying? Resolving Ambiguities in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models on underspecified prompts (e.g., occupations and activities) by introducing explicitly disambiguated prompts specifying gender (male vs. female), and measuring the models' ability to faithfully generate the specified identities using automated VQA models and human evaluation.

Evaluating text-to-image models on underspecified prompts by explicitly adding disambiguating text specifying skin tone (dark vs. light skin color) and measuring the generation faithfulness using VQA models and human evaluation.

Evaluating text-to-image models on underspecified prompts by explicitly adding disambiguating text specifying age (young vs. old) and measuring the generation faithfulness using VQA models and human evaluation.
